summary: The v48 uppercase V recording selects cmd.c’s versionshort row and stops because JavaScript admits neither that command at rhack’s repeated-command boundary nor a direct versionshort result arm. The whole source unit is version.c:doversion(): with menu_requested clear it prints getversionstring() and returns ECMD_OK; with menu_requested set it returns doextversion(). Existing getversionstring() and doextversion() implementations are source-backed and already serve #version; this task adds doversion() and wires the direct key without claiming whole rhack completion.

source.branch: cmd.c extcmdlist row 1926 binds uppercase V to versionshort/doversion with IFBURIED | GENERALCMD | CMD_M_PREFIX. version.c:doversion() returns doextversion() when iflags.menu_requested is true; otherwise it prints getversionstring() through pline and returns ECMD_OK. The ordinary uppercase V case exercises the no-prefix branch; mV exercises the menu-prefixed branch.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1926-1927 registers V as versionshort with doversion; nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:rhack invokes the row function and applies ECMD result handling.
js/extcmdlist_data.js already contains the versionshort row; js/cmd.js:rhack has no direct versionshort arm and ADMITTED_COMMANDS does not admit it.
dependencies: doversion consumes getversionstring() and, for menu_requested, the ECMD result from doextversion(). Both already have source-backed implementations: js/version.js:getversionstring and doextversion; prior closed goal div-cmd-doextversion-seed0106-20260916 verified the #version dispatch path.

evidence: The assigned admitted case v48-short-version-command-attempt1 has two recorded steps and first stops at step 1 after one matching screen and 2,897 matching RNG calls. The command byte is uppercase V; source attribution is version.c:doversion, as retained by the queue entry and baseline-b353fb527-v48.json.

Upstream cmd.c:1923-1927 distinguishes lowercase M(v), which dispatches doextversion, from uppercase V, which dispatches doversion. Upstream version.c:154-165 has two complete branches: menu_requested returns doextversion(); otherwise pline("%s", getversionstring(...)) then ECMD_OK. cmd.c:rhack invokes the bound row function and applies its ECMD_OK reset path at 3810-3825.

The JavaScript extended-command table already defines versionshort/doversion at js/extcmdlist_data.js:148, but js/cmd.js:ADMITTED_COMMANDS and rhack have no direct uppercase V execution branch. Existing js/version.js:getversionstring and doextversion are reused; the earlier closed goal div-cmd-doextversion-seed0106-20260916 records that existing #version path.
